correctness.rationale: The exact rooted-tree formula of Cúth and Raunig is applied with nonnegative subtree charges. Two cost-nonincreasing tree moves reduce every tree to a center-root plus two-level leaf attachment, giving a finite subset minimum. The power-mean inequality yields the universal inverse bound and singleton/equal-charge vectors attain both branches; endpoints and thresholds are checked. 16,807 trees and five test vectors independently agree with the norm identity to floating precision.
